context: End of day: tallying sales and restocking
purpose: Close the shop; teach 匹/ワン/在庫/もつ/だめ/とれ/我慢/垢

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今日は子犬、二匹も決まったわ。
lines.style: satisfied Kansai owner pleased with the day

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: よかったですね。ワンちゃんたち幸せそう。
lines.style: warm helper sharing in the good feeling

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: フードの在庫、だいぶ減ったな。
lines.en: The food stock has dropped a lot.
lines.style: observant owner checking the shelves, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 週末までもつか微妙ですね。
lines.en: Iffy whether it lasts till the weekend.
lines.style: practical helper flagging a supply risk

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 発注せな。切らしたらだめや。
lines.en: Got to order more. Running out is no good.
lines.style: decisive Kansai owner making the call

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 展示の首輪、いくつかとれてました。
lines.en: Some of the display collars had come off.
lines.style: attentive helper reporting a small issue

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 直しとくわ。お客さん来るまで我慢の作業や。
lines.en: I will fix them. Tedious work till customers come.
lines.style: dutiful owner resigned to the chore

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ケージの垢も拭いておきますね。
lines.en: I will wipe the grime off the cages too.
lines.style: conscientious helper finishing the cleanup, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
